title: LesionAgent: Training-Free Agentic Tumor Tracking and Response Assessment in Longitudinal CT
abstract: arXiv:2611.27876v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Every few months, a cancer patient's CT scans decide whether treatment continues. 3D foundation models can now detect, segment, register and track lesions, yet none of them reads the scans as a radiologist does. A radiologist decides which findings are lesions, which are the same lesion months later and whether a new spot means progression, and checks each decision against the extensive rules of a clinical guideline. We introduce LesionAgent, an LLM agent that performs this read end to end without task-specific training. It operates frozen 3D models as tools, acts in 3D through coordinate-labelled views, remembers every lesion across visits in a registry, verifies every model output it relies on, and leaves every number to a deterministic guideline engine. On four public longitudinal CT datasets, LesionAgent tracks more lesions and measures them more accurately than every automatic baseline, and where the same 3D models chained by fixe

translated_title: LesionAgent：纵向CT中无需训练的智能体式肿瘤追踪与疗效评估
translated_abstract: 每隔几个月，癌症患者的CT扫描结果就决定着治疗是否继续。3D基础模型如今已能检测、分割、配准和追踪病灶，但它们都无法像放射科医生那样阅读扫描图像。放射科医生会判断哪些发现是病灶、哪些是几个月后的同一病灶、新出现的斑点是否意味着病情进展，并对照临床指南中的大量规则核验每一项判断。我们提出LesionAgent——一个无需任何任务特定训练即可端到端完成这种阅片工作的LLM智能体。它将冻结的3D基础模型作为工具来调用，通过带坐标标注的视图在三维空间中进行操作，在登记册中记住跨随访的每一个病灶，验证它所依赖的每一个模型输出，并将所有数值测算交给确定性的指南引擎来完成。在四个公开的纵向CT数据集上，LesionAgent比所有自动化基线追踪到更多病灶且测量更准确；而将同样的3D模型用固定流程串联的方法（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出无需训练的LLM智能体LesionAgent，像放射科医生一样调用冻结的3D基础模型并对照临床指南，在纵向CT中实现端到端的肿瘤追踪与疗效评估，追踪数量和测量精度均超越所有自动化基线。
en_tdlr: LesionAgent is a training-free LLM agent that orchestrates frozen 3D foundation models like a radiologist to achieve end-to-end tumor tracking and response assessment in longitudinal CT, outperforming all automated baselines.
